name: qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4.pro6000ws-256k-fp8kv-dflash2
notes: NVFP4 'ultrafast' RTX PRO 6000 WS profile for RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 (modelopt MIXED: 193 module groups W4-float/A4-float + 208 W8-float/A8-float; 20.44 GiB / 21.95 GB, 22 files). The club-3090 single/dual NVFP4 tier, whose real case is Blackwell sm_120+ — the A4 4-bit-activation groups execute on FP4 tensor cores (on Ampere it is only a Marlin W4A16 compatibility path). Served with --quantization modelopt (force_quantization), dtype bfloat16, KV fp8_e4m3 (NVFP4 KV is NOT usable on consumer Blackwell — trtllm-gen FP4 FMHA is sm_100/103 only, vLLM #43562 — so KV stays fp8). DFlash2 W4A16 drafter n=7 (syvai, method=dflash) — the drafter shares the target lm_head, which MUST be bf16. RISK: the RadixArk checkpoint has lm_head quantized to NVFP4 (ignore list only covers the MTP head), so DFlash2 may fail at boot; if so, revert speculative_config to {method:mtp,num_speculative_tokens:3} (the MTP head IS bf16) — that is the club-3090 pairing. max_model_len 262144 (256k) — the 96 GB card has ~840k-token KV headroom at NVFP4 (22 GiB weights + 55 GiB KV pool), so the full 256k ladder is runnable; the 64k variant (qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4.pro6000ws-64k-fp8kv-dflash2.json) kept the club-3090 single-card VRAM floor. --no-async-scheduling mitigates the open vllm#50021 GDN spec-decode crash. Checkpoint on R2 at RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 (transfer profile qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4-radixark.json). language_model_only removed: checkpoint ships the full Qwen3.5 vision stack (333 model.visual.* tensors) — serves text+image+video.
